x.hook: The hidden math behind Tokenized Lending: The Future of Credit.
x.copy:
When volatility hits EVM money markets, priority gas auctions push transaction fees past $50. Small borrowers get wiped out because liquidation transactions get front-run.

We took a different approach on Stellar Soroban for Tokenized Lending: The Future of Credit.

Instead of putting every borrower into one big pool, Vanna gives each user an isolated SmartAccount contract. If a position drops, the loss stays inside that sandbox. Shared pools do not take a haircut.

Because Stellar uses deterministic fees, transactions confirm at 0.00014 XLM. No priority gas wars. Our Mercury indexer stream detects position health in ~320ms, giving keepers enough runway to rebalance at 1.25x before hitting the 1.10x liquidation floor.

You can test the contract sandboxes on testnet here: Deploy y...

linkedin.hook: Institutional Credit Mechanics: Tokenized Lending: The Future of Credit
linkedin.copy:
Why Tokenized Lending: The Future of Credit requires a structural shift away from pooled lending risk.

During market turbulence, decentralized money markets face two major bottlenecks: mempool congestion and shared pool contagion. When bad debt accumulates in a shared pool, passive liquidity providers absorb the haircut.

Vanna isolates credit execution at the smart contract level on Stellar Soroban. Each borrower manages leverage inside an independent SmartAccount sandbox. Deficits remain quarantined without haircutting global lending reserves.

The architecture is live on Stellar Testnet: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

reddit.copy:
**Title:** Technical breakdown: Tokenized Lending: The Future of Credit on Stellar Soroban

Here is how we designed Vanna's credit architecture on Soroban Protocol 20:

- State isolation inside dedicated SmartAccount contracts rather than monolithic pools
- Sub-second Mercury indexer streaming (~320ms) for real-time solvency monitoring
- Deterministic transaction fees fixed at 0.00014 XLM, eliminating MEV front-running

Documentation and testnet deployments: Deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance

*(Disclosure: Core builder at Vanna Protocol. Testing on Stellar Testnet.)*
